legacy.title: Take over previous installation
legacy.description: An installation under the former name “KNX2HOME Importer” was found. Its imported entities, settings and import state are taken over unchanged, and the package file is renamed to `packages/knx_project_sync.yaml`. Afterwards delete the old “KNX2HOME Importer” entry and remove it in HACS.

package_not_loaded.title: KNX package is not loaded
package_not_loaded.description:
The generated entities are in `{path}`, but Home Assistant does not load this file. Add to `configuration.yaml`:

```yaml
homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages
```

and restart Home Assistant.
